texts.hook: A cocaine trafficker made the billionaire list, won a seat in Congress, and paid for homes in a city he helped terrorize. That's Pablo Escobar. The money didn't just make him rich. It made him powerful.
texts.industry: A single flight could carry four hundred kilos of cocaine and bring in ten million dollars.
texts.close: But money alone doesn't explain this. How do you build that much power, and get people to defend it?
texts.title: PABLO ESCOBAR
